use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Eisenstein = (a: int, b: int)

is_prime(n: int) -> bool =>
    n >= 2 /\ ((2..n) |> filter(d => d * d <= n) |> all(d => n % d != 0))

norm(e: Eisenstein) -> int => e.a * e.a - e.a * e.b + e.b * e.b

is_eisenstein_prime(e: Eisenstein) -> bool =>
    if e.a == 0 \/ e.b == 0 \/ e.a == e.b then
        let p = Math.max(Math.abs(e.a), Math.abs(e.b)) in
        is_prime(p) /\ p % 3 == 2
    else
        is_prime(norm(e))
    fi

real(e: Eisenstein) -> double => cast double(e.a) - cast double(e.b) / 2.0D

imaginary(e: Eisenstein) -> double =>
    cast double(e.b) * Math.sqrt(3.0D) / 2.0D

show(e: Eisenstein) -> string =>
    let im = imaginary(e) in
    let sign = if im < 0.0D then "-" else "+" fi in
    "{real(e),8:F4} {sign} {Math.abs(im):F4}i"

let reach = 60

let primes =
    (-reach::reach)
        |> flat_map(a => (-reach::reach) |> map(b => (a = a, b = b)))
        |> filter(is_eisenstein_prime)
        |> sort((x, y) =>
            if norm(x) != norm(y) then norm(x) - norm(y)
            elif x.b != y.b then x.b - y.b
            else x.a - y.a
            fi)
        |> collect_list()

write_line("the first 100 Eisenstein primes, nearest 0 first:")

for row in 0..25 do
    let four = primes |> skip(row * 4) |> take(4)

    write_line(four |> map(show) |> join("  "))
od

let plotted = primes |> take(2000) |> collect_list()
let largest = plotted[plotted.count - 1]

write_line("")
write_line("plotted the first 2000, out to norm {norm(largest)}")

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)
let extent = Math.sqrt(cast double(norm(largest))) * 1.05D

image.view(-extent, -extent, extent, extent)
image.clear(10ub, 12ub, 25ub)
image.colour(120ub, 200ub, 255ub)

for e in plotted do
    image.dot(real(e), imaginary(e), 1.6D)
od

image.write("eisenstein.png")

image.show("eisenstein.png")
